scope: CPU-only independent non-author review of task-owned W128 resume wrapper; no GPU/service/API/lock operation was performed by reviewer.

facts: original root and service group dead

static_binding_checks: main requires root_approved_remaining_one_service, exact wrapper hash, original sealed admission through window_runner.require_seal, and a pinned independent-review artifact.

prior_rows validates every name/digest supplied in sealed prior_hashes, rejects symlinks, writable files, or digest mismatch, then reuses the eight metric rows verbatim and validates their input hashes/native digests/completion counts plus W98 auto slots.
measure selects only packet arms[1] (W128K), sets previous_actual_services=1 and actual_new_services=1, and never dispatches W98.
each W128 A native hash is compared to its prior W98 counterpart before B/cold; B09 retains 100223 frontend check; B09-B12 and cold retain existing capacity/cached/min-free checks.
finish_owned preserves stop exceptions but requires group dead, both ports bindable, and GPU idle before writing cleanup_receipt; otherwise unsafe cleanup retains lock.
